fields.statement: A review run journals check-session, check-judged, check, check-cycle, review-question, code-check and signoff entries, and the change-set fixer's review-fix and review-fix-judged; a check's outcome is its own check entry, apart from the session's judgement, and a findings round carries its cycle. The checks state survives entered, so a re-entered checks step keeps its cycles and a check counts by its latest outcome.
fields.wording: the agent's choice in its plan, approved by the orchestrator acting as arbiter at plan approval

fields.statement: Check and critic sessions run in parallel, each in a throwaway detached checkout at the run worktree's HEAD, with RHIZA_ROOT pointing their rhiza writes at the run worktree. The checkout comes from its own OpenCheckCheckout path rather than the leaves' OpenCheckout, so a check's checkout can never collide with a leaf verifier's.
fields.wording: the agent's choice in its plan, approved by the orchestrator acting as arbiter at plan approval

fields.statement: Once a check or critic session is judged, the model entries its actor wrote (plus that actor's record entries) are committed in the run worktree, one commit per session; a failure to commit is logged and the judgement stands.
fields.wording: the implementing agent's choice, accepted by the orchestrator acting as arbiter

fields.statement: Critics start only after every check session of the cycle is judged, and then all of them start before any is polled. A critic session that fails fails its check, which re-runs next cycle like any failed check.
fields.wording: the implementing agent's choice, accepted by the orchestrator acting as arbiter

fields.statement: A blocker or major finding that a critic gave no verdict on counts as confirmed, and the summary lists it under Confirmed as standing for want of a verdict.
fields.wording: the agent's choice in its plan, approved by the orchestrator acting as arbiter at plan approval

fields.statement: Leaf fixers and the verifiers that re-run after them are journalled as leaf-session and leaf-attempt entries on the checks step, with Attempt equal to the cycle, so the leaves step's start, poll, judge and run findings --leaf paths are reused. No leaf outcome entry is written on a checks step.
fields.wording: the agent's choice in its plan, approved by the orchestrator acting as arbiter at plan approval

fields.statement: Fixers run one at a time because they share the run worktree: leaf fixers in leaf order, then the one change-set fixer, with a fixed leaf's verifier running beside the next fixer. Only the checks that failed re-run, once every fixer and verifier is judged.
fields.wording: the agent's choice in its plan, approved by the orchestrator acting as arbiter at plan approval

fields.statement: The change-set fixer is journalled with its own review-fix and review-fix-judged entries, one per cycle, not as a leaf or check session. It gets the confirmed findings that name no leaf or a leaf outside the change set, and its commit carries a Review: trailer.
fields.wording: the implementing agent's choice, accepted by the orchestrator acting as arbiter

fields.statement: The fix phase belongs to cycle N+1: it runs after that cycle's check-cycle entry and before its check sessions, and a fixer's RHIZA_CYCLE is N+1. A failed fixer or verifier fails every check of that cycle with a fix-failed detail, so a failed fix uses up the cycle.
fields.wording: the implementing agent's choice, accepted by the orchestrator acting as arbiter

fields.statement: MaxFixCycles is 2, so a checks step runs at most three cycles, the first plus two fix cycles, before its standing findings become questions.
fields.wording: the agent's choice in its plan, approved by the orchestrator acting as arbiter at plan approval

fields.statement: An owner's request for changes and an answered set of questions each buy exactly one cycle outside the cap, and a failure in that cycle goes straight to questions. Owner findings are all fixed whatever their severity.
fields.wording: the implementing agent's choice, accepted by the orchestrator acting as arbiter

fields.statement: rhiza run approve [run] and rhiza run request-changes <file> [run] take the run by ref or the latest, exit 2 unless it is stopped at a signoff step, and resume the engine in-process; each requested change names a check, which re-runs. The built-in review.toml sets max_visits = 3 on its checks and signoff steps, and request-changes exits 2 when another visit would pass that cap.
fields.wording: the agent's choice in its plan, approved by the orchestrator acting as arbiter at plan approval

fields.statement: Review sessions get RHIZA_CHECK, RHIZA_CYCLE and RHIZA_ROLE (check, critic, fixer or verifier); check and critic prompts take {check} and {cycle}, and the fixer prompt takes {leaf} and {cycle}, with {leaf} empty for the change-set fixer.
fields.wording: the agent's choice in its plan, approved by the orchestrator acting as arbiter at plan approval

fields.statement: The review guide names a QA check's Evidence <leaf>-qa-<cycle>, the cycle being RHIZA_CYCLE, so a QA check that re-runs in a later cycle does not collide with its earlier Evidence.
fields.wording: the implementing agent's choice, accepted by the orchestrator acting as arbiter
